design_configuration.rationale: Larger matched-n candidates after retained original-size failures. Separate exact finite-n text estimands, interval coverage, boundary false equivalence, null families and actual captured-wire power. Original faults, margins and reference controls are unchanged; no automatic provider qualification.

B01.rationale: three percent of local prompt tokens, after matched-input reference overhead calibration; no absolute template assumption

FP1.rationale: three hundredths of a bit of mean JSD displacement from matched-n same-model controls; first declared for the offline lab

FP2.rationale: three percentage points of fixed-length normalized Hamming-MMD displacement from matched-n same-model controls

P03.cache.rationale: three percentage points of adjacent completion-change frequency, clustered by independent prompt

P07.rationale: SPEC S1: ratio 1.25 ignored boundary; PASS clears half the reference ratio; positive offset defines log ratios at observed zero

T01.rationale: KVV-style trigger agreement varies a few points run to run

T02.rationale: two points of schema accuracy is user-visible at agent scale

comparative_defaults.rationale: Three percentage points for generated binary capability outcomes; check-specific values override

invariant_defaults.rationale: SPEC 19.1: repeated, replayed violations; clean PASS needs a tight 95% upper bound

statistics.rationale: SPEC 12: family-wise verdicts, paired designs and at least 2000 bootstrap draws

limitations: Scripted responses and simulation distributions; not real-provider reliability
No model weights, hardware or quantization attestation
scope: Known heterogeneous iid categorical strata and fixed-anchor Gaussian-logit components only; not provider dependence, interval coverage or captured-wire power
